source_review.notes: Checked current official NASA fundamentals, Logical Decomposition, Design Solution Definition, Interface Management, Product Integration, integration-plan and Configuration Management guidance; active NASA-HDBK-1009A; final OMG SysML 2.0; and ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022. Nine final URLs returned HTTP 200 through direct command-line retrieval. ISO returned HTTP 403 to scripted curl but its official current publication record was independently retrieved through browser access on the review date. Claims are bounded to definition/usage, containment/reference, ports/connections, configured views, interfaces, integration and architecture-description concerns.

evidence: Reviewed the typed attributed multigraph, containment ownership/acyclicity conditions, compatibility conjunction, usage tuple and boundary-cut expression.
Confirmed vertices, containment, references, connections, allocations, ports/properties and configuration are separately typed.
Confirmed structural compatibility is explicitly necessary but insufficient for performance, safety, security, timing, reliability and operations.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The graph formalism structures architecture description and configured integrity; it does not prove architecture adequacy.

evidence: Executed structure-model-integrity-check and reproduced six elements: one system root, four owned internal elements and one external environment.
Recomputed four containment edges, exactly one parent for every owned child and zero containment cycles.

Recomputed 13 ports and eight connections with zero missing endpoints, zero type-string mismatches and zero direction-rule errors across assembly, external, inbound delegation and outbound delegation kinds.
Confirmed two external boundary connections, four allocated functions and structure_model_consistent exact output.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Exact type strings and simple direction rules are teaching proxies; no multiplicity, capacity, protocol, unit conversion, timing, physical fit or common-cause evidence is computed.

evidence: Confirmed ordinary owned usages require a single lifecycle parent and acyclic containment while references and allocations do not transfer ownership.
Confirmed definition constraints are applied through a usage with its own role, owner, multiplicity, values and configured applicability.
Confirmed boundary-cut membership uses exclusive ownership membership, so connections crossing into or out of the system-owned set are externally governed.
Confirmed delegation directions are interpreted relative to parent and child owners rather than forced into sibling assembly semantics.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Many-to-many logical/physical allocation and external references remain permitted without corrupting composition.

evidence: Challenged type/usage/instance confusion, two-owner composition, containment cycles, visual nesting, reporting-line/product hierarchy conflation, identifier reuse and unconfigured references.
Reviewed omitted people/procedures/facilities/services, undeclared externals, shadow dependencies, boundary authority, black boxes and supplier/version/rights/exit gaps.
Reviewed generic/bidirectional ports, copied interface values, dangling endpoints, assembly/delegation confusion, schema/unit/protocol/state mismatch, adapters, shared buses and unmodeled item flows.
Reviewed unallocated/shared behavior, logical/physical/deployment conflation, variants, topology, multiplicity, voting/failover, trust/failure zones and false redundancy under common cause.
Reviewed as-built/as-deployed mismatch, runtime inventory authority, emergency change, drift, integration evidence and propagated effects across requirements, hazards, budgets and tests.
Reviewed all ten examples and five answers for context, ownership, configured identity, interface semantics, allocation, evidence and lifecycle control.
